title: 2013 Honda Pilot Dent Repair and Fender Replacement
summary: Carcis Autobody Repair replaced the driver-side fender and refinished all four door moldings on a 2013 Honda Pilot in Maroon.
story: This 2013 Honda Pilot arrived at Carcis Autobody Repair requiring body repair to the driver-side panels. The driver-side front fender sustained damage severe enough to warrant a full panel replacement.

Technicians removed the damaged front fender and fitted a new replacement panel. All four side door moldings were sanded down, repaired with body filler where gouged, and primed to create a smooth base for paint.
Once the prep work was complete, the new fender and door moldings were sprayed with color-matched Maroon paint and clear coat to match the vehicle's factory finish.
